name: kelvia-mcp

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List all Kelvia boards accessible to the authenticated user. Returns id, name, slug, isArchived, columns (kanban columns), stages (sprints/milestones), config (custom priorities and statuses), taskCounter, createdAt.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Get detailed info for a single board by its URL slug (slug is the short identifier in board URLs, e.g. 'my-project'). Includes all columns, stages with their statuses, board config and member count.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters. Without any filter returns all tasks the user has access to across every board. By default returns a COMPACT shape to stay within token limits: { board: { id, name, slug, columns } | null, tasks: [{ id, number, title, status, priority, columnId, stageId, tags (names), assignees (count), dueDate }], count }. Pass detailed=true for full task objects (heavy — can exceed limits on large boards) or use get_task / get_task_by_number for one full task.

board_slug.description: Board slug — limits results to tasks of that board

today.description: Return only today's relevant tasks (assigned to user, due today or overdue)

date.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD — filter tasks by this date

search.description: Search in task title/description; numeric value also matches task number

detailed.description: Return full task objects instead of the compact shape (default false)

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return

tools.name: list_daily_tasks
tools.description: List tasks relevant for today (assigned to me and not done, or due today). Optional board filter by slug.

tools.name: list_calendar_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with a due date inside a date range, for a calendar view. Unlike list_tasks, this is scoped by due date range rather than status/search filters.

board_slug.description: Board slug — limits results to tasks of that board

tools.name: list_daily_plan_blocks
tools.description: List the user's personal day-planner blocks (their own time-blocking schedule) visible on a given local date, with each block's done/not-done status for that date. Different from list_daily_tasks, which lists board tasks due today — this is the user's private schedule, not board tasks.

local_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD to view the plan for

tools.name: list_daily_plan_definitions
tools.description: List the user's day-planner block definitions as stored (recurrence rule, scheduled time, active_from) — not resolved against a specific date, unlike list_daily_plan_blocks.

tools.name: list_overdue_daily_plan_blocks
tools.description: List the user's day-planner blocks that were due before the given local date and are still not done.

local_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD — blocks overdue relative to this date

tools.name: create_daily_plan_block
tools.description: Create a block in the user's personal day-planner (their own time-blocking schedule, not a board task). Title may reference a board task with `@boardSlug/N` (e.g. `@marketing/42`) — the app renders it as a clickable link to that task. Returns the created block.

title.description: Block title. Use `@boardSlug/N` to link a board task inside the title.

recurrence.description: Repeat rule (default DAILY). ONCE requires scheduled_day.

scheduled_day.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD — required when recurrence=ONCE

scheduled_time.description: Start time HH:mm local time, or null for unscheduled

end_time.description: End time HH:mm local time, or null

active_from.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD the block starts applying from (default: applies from the start)

tools.name: update_daily_plan_block
tools.description: Update fields of an existing day-planner block. Pass only the fields you want to change. Title may reference a board task with `@boardSlug/N`. Returns the updated block.

title.description: New title — use `@boardSlug/N` to link a board task

recurrence.description: New repeat rule. ONCE requires scheduled_day.

scheduled_day.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear

scheduled_time.description: Start time HH:mm, or null to clear

end_time.description: End time HH:mm, or null to clear

tools.name: set_daily_plan_block_status
tools.description: Mark a day-planner block done or not-done for one specific local date (recurring blocks track completion per-day, not globally).

tools.name: reorder_daily_plan_blocks
tools.description: Reorder the day-planner blocks visible on a given local date (drag-and-drop equivalent). Pass ALL block UUIDs visible on that date, in the desired order.

ordered_ids.description: Every block UUID visible on local_date, in the new order

local_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD whose visible list is being reordered

tools.name: delete_daily_plan_block
tools.description: Remove a day-planner block starting from a given local date onward (soft-delete — earlier occurrences and their completion history are kept).

local_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD from which the block stops appearing

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full details of a single task by its UUID. Includes all fields: title, description, status, priority, dueDate, assignees, watchers, tags, stage, parent task, subtasks, worklogs (time tracking), and comments count.

tools.name: get_task_by_number
tools.description: Get a task by its human-friendly number (the #N shown in the UI) within a board. Resolves the number to the task UUID and returns full details (same shape as get_task). Handy when you know the #N but not the UUID.

board_slug.description: Board slug the task belongs to

number.description: Task number — the #N in the UI, without the '#'

tools.name: get_task_comments
tools.description: Get all comments for a task ordered by creation time. Each comment includes id, content, createdAt, updatedAt and the author (user).

tools.name: get_task_worklogs
tools.description: Get time-tracking worklogs for a task. Each entry has id, minutes, comment, workedAt, and the author.

tools.name: get_task_activity
tools.description: Get the audit trail for a task: who changed what and when (status/priority/assignee/field changes, comments, worklogs), newest first.

tools.name: get_board_activity
tools.description: Get the audit trail for a whole board: task/stage/member changes across the board, newest first. Requires ADMIN/OWNER role on that board.

actor_id.description: Filter by the user who performed the action

from.description: ISO date — only activity at or after this time

to.description: ISO date — only activity at or before this time

tools.name: list_board_members
tools.description: List all members of a board with their roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER). Use list_boards first to obtain the board id.

tools.name: update_board_member
tools.description: Update board member role/title. Requires ADMIN/OWNER on that board.

tools.name: remove_board_member
tools.description: Remove a member from board. Requires ADMIN/OWNER.

tools.name: list_board_invitations
tools.description: List pending/accepted/declined invitations for a board. Requires ADMIN/OWNER.

tools.name: create_board_invitation
tools.description: Invite a user to board by email with role ADMIN/MEMBER/VIEWER. Requires ADMIN/OWNER.

tools.name: revoke_board_invitation
tools.description: Revoke an invitation by id. Requires ADMIN/OWNER.

tools.name: list_my_invitations
tools.description: List board invitations sent to the current user (pending/accepted/declined), with the inviting board and role.

tools.name: accept_board_invitation
tools.description: Accept a pending board invitation sent to the current user. Returns the created board membership.

tools.name: decline_board_invitation
tools.description: Decline a pending board invitation sent to the current user.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user (id, email, firstName, lastName, avatarUrl).

tools.name: list_board_tags
tools.description: Get the tag vocabulary of a board. Tags belong to the board and are shared by everyone on it — the same name on another board is a different tag. Returns id and name; use the ids in create_task/update_task tag_ids, or just pass tag_names and let the board pick up new ones.

tools.name: list_board_columns
tools.description: Get kanban columns for a board by slug. Returns id and name for each column — use these IDs in create_task and update_task.

tools.name: create_board_stage
tools.description: Create a stage on a board. Requires ADMIN/OWNER role on that board.

carry_over_task_ids.description: Task ids to move into the new stage

tools.name: materialize_board_backlog_stage
tools.description: Create (or fetch, if it already exists) the special backlog stage for a board — holds tasks that aren't part of any active/planned stage. Requires ADMIN/OWNER role on that board.

tools.name: update_board_stage
tools.description: Rename a board stage.

tools.name: delete_board_stage
tools.description: Delete a board stage.

tools.name: reorder_board_stages
tools.description: Reorder stages on a board by passing full ordered list of stage IDs.

ordered_stage_ids.description: All stage IDs in target order

tools.name: start_board_stage
tools.description: Set stage status to ACTIVE.

tools.name: complete_board_stage
tools.description: Set stage status to COMPLETED (frozen).

tools.name: reopen_board_stage
tools.description: Reopen stage from COMPLETED to ACTIVE.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task on a board. Requires the board slug and a title. Returns the created task with its generated id and number.

board_slug.description: Board slug where the task will be created

column_id.description: Kanban column ID (use list_board_columns to get IDs)

stage_id.description: Stage ID (use get_board to see stages)

status.description: Task status. Default values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, NEEDS_INFO, DONE (= "Closed - done"), CLOSED (= "Closed - won't do"). Use NEEDS_INFO when the task is blocked waiting for clarification. A board may define custom statuses — read board.config.statuses from get_board.

priority.description: Priority, low to high: MINOR, ORDINARY ("Low"), MEDIUM, IMPORTANT ("High"), BLOCKER. A board may define custom priorities — read board.config.priorities from get_board.

tag_names.description: Tag names for this task. Tags live on the board: a name that isn't there yet is created on it, an existing one is reused (case-insensitive). Max 10 per task.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs from list_board_tags (must belong to the same board)

assignee_ids.description: Array of user UUIDs to assign

watcher_ids.description: Array of user UUIDs to add as watchers

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update one or more fields of an existing task. Pass only the fields you want to change — all are optional. Returns the updated task.

status.description: New status. Default values: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, NEEDS_INFO, DONE (= "Closed - done"), CLOSED (= "Closed - won't do"). Use NEEDS_INFO when the task is blocked waiting for clarification. A board may define custom statuses — read board.config.statuses from get_board.

priority.description: New priority, low to high: MINOR, ORDINARY ("Low"), MEDIUM, IMPORTANT ("High"), BLOCKER. A board may define custom priorities — read board.config.priorities from get_board.

due_date.description: New due date as ISO string, or null to clear

column_id.description: Move to this kanban column ID (use list_board_columns to get IDs)

stage_id.description: Assign to this stage ID, or null to remove (use get_board to see stages)

tag_names.description: Replace the whole tag list with these names (empty array clears all tags). Names are found on the board or created there. Max 10 per task.

tag_ids.description: Replace the whole tag list with these tag IDs (empty array clears all tags)

parent_id.description: Set parent task UUID, or null to make top-level

assignee_ids.description: Replace full assignee list with these user UUIDs

watcher_ids.description: Replace full watcher list with these user UUIDs

tools.name: reorder_task
tools.description: Move/reorder a task inside a column (kanban drag-and-drop equivalent).

position.description: New numeric position in the column

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task by its UUID. Only the task creator or a board OWNER/ADMIN can delete tasks. Returns a confirmation message.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a task. Returns the created comment with author info.

tools.name: get_task_summary
tools.description: Read a task's summary — the single digest shown in its Summary tab. Returns { summary, summaryUpdatedAt, summaryAuthor }.

tools.name: set_task_summary
tools.description: Write or replace a task's summary: a concise digest of the task's current state and what has been done, shown in the task's Summary tab. Markdown supported. Replaces any previous summary (one per task).

summary.description: Summary text — a concise digest (markdown supported)

tools.name: update_task_comment
tools.description: Update an existing task comment.

tools.name: delete_task_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a task. You can only delete your own comments.

tools.name: add_task_worklog
tools.description: Log time spent on a task. minutes must be > 0 and ≤ 1440 (24 hours). Returns the created worklog entry.

comment.description: Optional note about the work done (max 2000 chars)

worked_at.description: ISO datetime when the work was done (defaults to now)

tools.name: update_task_worklog
tools.description: Update an existing worklog entry for a task.

tools.name: delete_task_worklog
tools.description: Delete a worklog entry from a task.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new board. Optionally supply an array of column names (defaults to a standard set). Returns the created board with its generated slug.

columns.description: Kanban column names in order (e.g. ['Backlog', 'In Progress', 'Done'])

tools.name: update_board
tools.description: Update a board's name or column list. Pass only the fields you want to change. Changing columns reorders/renames them. Returns the updated board.

columns.description: New ordered list of column names

tools.name: delete_board
tools.description: Delete a board by UUID.

tools.name: archive_board
tools.description: Archive a board by UUID.

tools.name: unarchive_board
tools.description: Unarchive a board by UUID.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags across every board you can access. Tags belong to boards, so the same name on two boards is two different tags — each item carries its board. For one board use list_board_tags.

tools.name: create_board_tag
tools.description: Add a tag to a board's vocabulary. Tags live on the board and are shared by everyone on it. Usually you don't need this: create_task/update_task tag_names create missing tags by themselves.

instructions: Kelvia is a task manager operated through boards, tasks, comments, worklogs, stages, members, and a personal day planner. Use list_boards before board-scoped work and prefer compact list_tasks results, then get_task for one full record. Before mutations, resolve human task references with get_task_by_number and confirm the target board. Treat delete, remove, revoke, archive, stage completion, invitation, and member-role tools as consequential writes. Never expose API tokens in tool arguments, task text, comments, or URLs.
